verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 is GPU accelerator hardware and a DGX server system. "Bulk operations across many items" is an application-level workflow feature, such as acting on many records or tasks at once, and is a category error for compute hardware. The node-wide GPU administration and cluster-management software in the pack is a different capability (fleet monitoring and management), not documented bulk item operations, so it does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
